name: Who chewed me
desc:
The lights go out. 
You’re in bed. 
A shadow creeps from the corner of your screen—then snap—your Limbs are gone.

Hunt down the Flesh Thief before they take the rest of you. 
Time’s running out… and the lights are still off.

Survive. Solve. Escape.
